To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

vocabulary work in the course of literary texts analysis in the modern textbooks for a multi ethnic school has been developed in a way that it is not enough to teach the learners of different languages and nationalities the words and expressions used in literary texts; the teachers should also help the students to understand the meaning of these words, expressions, and phrases in the context of the culture, customs and traditions, history, and life of the people whose literature they study.

the study of literary text in multi ethnic school should be carried out in a way which allows to reveal the interconnection between the literary work and the cultural and historical context, and the learners should be given a chance to use their own language and culture as a means for understanding a literary text in the language of its origin.
vocabulary work in the course of literary texts analysis in a multiethnic school is a necessary condition for successful teaching and learning of Russian language and literature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of vocabulary work in the course of studying literary texts in multiethnic schools.
the necessity for the development of vocabulary work on literary texts in multiethnic schools.
the necessity of a special vocabulary work in the process of analyzing literary texts in multiethnic schools.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
vocabulary work in the process of literary texts analysis in multi ethnic schools requires a special approach.

vocabulary work in the course of analyzing literary texts in multiethnic schools is a very complex process, which should be based on the principles and rules of the theory of vocabulary work and the theory of literary texts.

the study of literary works in the multi ethnic schools requires a special approach to the organization of the vocabulary work in the course of literary text analysis, the use of special vocabulary work techniques, including the use of a special vocabulary commentary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the vocabulary work based on the analysis of literary texts is an essential component of the literary and aesthetic education of learners of multiethnic schools, and it can be realized only on the basis of a comprehensive study of the text, which includes the study of vocabulary and the study of the cultural context.

in the process of studying literary texts in a multicultural school it is necessary to use the following methods of teaching: a comparative analysis of the literary texts, a comparative analysis of literary and culturological vocabulary, a comparative analysis between the literary and the culturological commentary, a comparative analysis with the help of the literary text, the literary text as a source of culturological vocabulary.

the vocabulary work in the process of analyzing literary texts in the modern textbook for a multi ethnic school is aimed at the development of the students' ability to understand literary works in their historical and cultural context and to master a literary text in a foreign language, as well as at the formation of the students' linguistic culture, their ability to use the language of a literary text as a means for the expression of their own thoughts and ideas.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the analysis of a literary text is a complex and multifaceted process which requires a special work with a vocabulary, and that it is impossible to analyze a literary text without a thorough work with the vocabulary.

the study of literary text in a multi ethnic environment requires a special approach to the teaching of the Russian language, which is based on the analysis of cultural and historical context and the use of culturological vocabulary.
the vocabulary of literary texts is a special language system which requires special methods of teaching and learning.
